titleEn: Check if There Is a Valid Parentheses String Path
title: 检查是否有合法括号字符串路径
summary: 从网格左上仅向右或向下走到右下，沿途括号能否组成合法括号串。
insight: 路径长度固定。用三维布尔 DP 记录到每格可达的括号余额；进入左括号加一、右括号减一，任何负余额舍弃，终点检查余额零。
pitfalls: 路径字符数必须为偶数
首字符必须左括号且末字符必须右括号
余额可以在终点前回到零但不能为负

solutions.title: 网格括号余额 DP
solutions.idea: 把每条路径压缩成其当前未匹配左括号数量。
steps: 长度奇数或首尾错误直接 false
逐格逐 balance 向右下邻格转移 newBalance=balance±1，保留 0..pathLength
返回终点 balance0 状态

code.java: class Solution { public boolean hasValidPath(char[][] grid){int rows=grid.length,columns=grid[0].length,length=rows+columns-1;if((length&1)==1||grid[0][0]!= '('||grid[rows-1][columns-1]!=')')return false;boolean[][][] reachable=new boolean[rows][columns][length+2];reachable[0][0][1]=true;int[][] directions={{1,0},{0,1}};for(int r=0;r<rows;r++)for(int c=0;c<columns;c++)for(int balance=0;balance<=length;balance++)if(reachable[r][c][balance])for(int[] direction:directions){int nr=r+direction[0],nc=c+direction[1];if(nr>=rows||nc>=columns)continue;int next=balance+(grid[nr][nc]=='('?1:-1);if(next>=0&&next<=length)reachable[nr][nc][next]=true;}return reachable[rows-1][columns-1][0];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun hasValidPath(grid:Array<CharArray>):Boolean{val rows=grid.size;val columns=grid[0].size;val length=rows+columns-1;if(length%2==1||grid[0][0]!='('||grid[rows-1][columns-1]!=')')return false;val reachable=Array(rows){Array(columns){BooleanArray(length+2)}};reachable[0][0][1]=true;val directions=arrayOf(intArrayOf(1,0),intArrayOf(0,1));for(r in 0 until rows)for(c in 0 until columns)for(balance in 0..length)if(reachable[r][c][balance])for(direction in directions){val nr=r+direction[0];val nc=c+direction[1];if(nr>=rows||nc>=columns)continue;val next=balance+if(grid[nr][nc]=='(')1 else -1;if(next in 0..length)reachable[nr][nc][next]=true};return reachable[rows-1][columns-1][0]} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:bool hasValidPath(vector<vector<char>>& grid){int rows=grid.size(),columns=grid[0].size(),length=rows+columns-1;if(length%2||grid[0][0]!='('||grid[rows-1][columns-1]!=')')return false;vector reachable(rows,vector(columns,vector<bool>(length+2)));reachable[0][0][1]=true;int directions[3]={1,0,1};for(int r=0;r<rows;++r)for(int c=0;c<columns;++c)for(int balance=0;balance<=length;++balance)if(reachable[r][c][balance])for(int d=0;d<2;++d){int nr=r+directions[d],nc=c+directions[d+1];if(nr>=rows||nc>=columns)continue;int next=balance+(grid[nr][nc]=='('?1:-1);if(next>=0&&next<=length)reachable[nr][nc][next]=true;}return reachable[rows-1][columns-1][0];} };
